experiment_data.hypothesis: OpenVLA 7B finetuned VLA-only baseline on LIBERO-Object using official eval code (transformers 4.40.1, isolated conda env). v1 failed due to transformers 5.8 DynamicCache bug. Dry-run on libero_spatial confirmed 80% SR. This run uses openvla-libero-object finetuned model with 10 trials/task.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/autodl-tmp/conda_envs/openvla/bin/activate && cd /root/autodl-tmp/openvla && MUJOCO_GL=egl python experiments/robot/libero/run_libero_eval.py --model_family openvla --pretrained_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/models/openvla-libero-object --task_suite_name libero_object --center_crop True --num_trials_per_task 10 --seed 42 --local_log_dir /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/results/eval-openvla-object-vla-only-seed42-v2"
